title: API Token Controls
scope: Admin controls, logging and revocation for API credentials on SaaS platforms. Sourced from vendor documentation; not an audit of any tenant.

definitions.conditional: Documented, with plan, policy or endpoint conditions.
definitions.excluded: The named control explicitly does not cover this credential.
definitions.not_supported: Vendor documentation states this credential lacks the control.
definitions.unknown: No source found either way. Not a negative finding.
definitions.not_verified: No source found either way. Not a negative finding.
definitions.not_applicable: Does not apply to this credential.
definitions.limited: Documented for a narrower case only.

providers.name: SailPoint Identity Security Cloud
providers.scope_notes: Covers SailPoint Identity Security Cloud (SailPoint Human Fabric). SaaS tenant (docs now branded SailPoint Human Fabric); VA is customer-hosted; no plan gating found for these token controls.

controls.name: Delete VA
controls.what: Deleting the VA removes its VA key.
controls.setting: Admin > Connections > Virtual Appliances > Edit > Virtual Appliances > Delete

controls_unknown: Any org setting to disable PAT creation or require approval for PATs/API clients
Any admin-enforced maximum PAT lifetime (API states no upper limit on expirationDate but the doc only says this, not that no policy exists)
Whether Network Settings IP/geo restrictions apply to /oauth/token or API calls
Whether deleting a PAT or API client invalidates already-issued bearer tokens (scope changes do not affect existing bearer tokens)
Audit event names for PAT/API client create, use, delete (published sample list is partial and lists none)
Whether API read calls (search, list identities) produce audit events
Whether disabling the owning identity stops its PATs
VA key lifetime, rotation and use logging

authentication.summary: Creating a VA generates a VA key that appears as type VA on the API Management page. Each VA holds an RSA private key derived from the cluster keyPassphrase that decrypts source credentials.

ip_restriction.boundary: No documented IP binding for VA keys.

administration.summary: VA key cannot be created or deleted on API Management; delete the VA to remove it, then shut down the VA instance.
administration.conditions: Admin access to Connections > Virtual Appliances

offboard.details: The VA key is created with the virtual appliance, not tied to a user.

inventory.details: VA keys appear on the API Management page with Type 'VA'.

token_format.notes: VA key listed as Type VA on API Management.

anomaly_cues: VA key use from outside the appliance network

containment.steps: Delete the VA, then shut down the VA instance.
containment.notes: Rotation of keyPassphrase not covered here.

evidence.title: Managing API Keys and Personal Access Tokens
